notes: "phần lớn dân chơi buộc nó lên lũa" overstates the source, which only says Anubias 'thường được gắn lên lũa'. It turns that into a claim about what most hobbyists do.

"Bụi ráy to thường có rễ rất dài" comes from the guide on tying a large Anubias clump onto big driftwood, not from information about nana specifically. It's general Anubias advice presented as nana advice.
"rồi cứ đổ nghiêng mãi": the word 'mãi' adds emphasis the source doesn't have ('cây sẽ lỏng ra và cứ đổ nghiêng').
The advice to split the clump to spread it across many spots applies to a large piece of driftwood in the source ('nếu lũa lớn'). The passage drops that condition.
"chứ không trồng như cây nền" goes slightly beyond the INPUT: the vị trí figure only says it grows attached to driftwood and rock, and nothing says not to plant it in the substrate.

"dù trồng nhiều vẫn dễ bị rêu hại ở giai đoạn đầu" and the advice to plant fast-growing plants alongside come from the algae guide, which covers new tanks in general. This is algae advice, not placement or planting, so it is a little off the passage's topic.
"dùng nhíp khều sạch bông đá" is general prep advice for potted plants. The INPUT never applies it to Bucephalandra specifically. It is supported, but generalised to this plant.
"chứ không phải dưới nền" is an added caution. The INPUT only gives the position as 'sống bám trên lũa, đá' and never says not to plant it in the substrate.
"trong mấy tuần đầu" is more specific than the source's "giai đoạn đầu".

"thả thêm cây thả nổi để chúng hút bớt dinh dưỡng dư": the guide credits fast-growing plants with absorbing excess nutrients. For floating plants it only says they grow fast because they take CO2 from the air, so this attribution is stretched.
"Bạn nên dùng nhíp khều thật sạch": the guide says to remove as much rock wool as possible and uses tweezers only for the root-bound half. "thật sạch" overstates this a little.
"Mấy tuần đầu bể dễ lên rêu": the INPUT only says "giai đoạn đầu" of a newly set-up tank. "Mấy tuần" is an added timeframe, and the passage drops the new-tank context.
"sẽ đỡ rêu hơn nhiều": the INPUT says fast-growing plants take up excess nutrients and keep algae from spreading. "hơn nhiều" overstates this.

"Nếu mua cây chậu, bạn nên gỡ bông đá...": this advice comes from a general prep guide, not one about this plant. It's acceptable, but the INPUT never says Degori is sold potted; the page says it's sold as rhizomes.
"Mấy tuần đầu": the INPUT says "giai đoạn đầu" of a newly set-up tank (bể mới). It gives no number of weeks, and the passage leaves out the new-tank context.

"hoặc thả thêm cây nổi để chúng hút bớt dinh dưỡng dư": the INPUT says only fast-growing plants absorb excess nutrients. Floating plants are said to grow fast because they take CO2 from the air, not to absorb nutrients.
"chứ không phải dưới nền": the INPUT never says not to plant it in the substrate. This is inferred from "sống bám trên lũa, đá".

"Cây chậu mua về thường còn dính bông đá": the rock-wool advice is a general tip for potted plants. The plant's page describes it as sold in rhizome portions (Single/Double/Triple), so this may not apply to this plant.
"không trồng xuống nền như cây thường" is a caution the INPUT never gives. The INPUT only says the plant grows attached to driftwood or rock ("sống bám trên lũa, đá").
"phải gỡ hết bông đá" is stronger than the source, which says to remove the rock wool "càng nhiều càng tốt" (as much as possible).
"mấy tuần đầu" is a time frame the source doesn't give. The source only says "giai đoạn đầu" (the early stage).
"hút bớt dinh dưỡng dư" weakens the source, which says fast-growing plants "hút hết dinh dưỡng dư" (absorb all the excess nutrients). The fact is still broadly intact.
Awkward, ambiguous gloss: "Bucep (tên dân chơi hay gọi Bucephalandra)" reads as if Bucephalandra is the nickname. The source has it the other way round: "dân chơi hay gọi tắt là Bucep".
"khều hết bông đá" goes further than the source, which says "gỡ đi càng nhiều càng tốt" and "khều từng chút".
The rock-wool section assumes a potted plant, but the product page lists "Quy cách: 3 thân rễ" (3 rhizomes). The 'if potted' condition keeps it accurate, but it's a weak fit for this plant.
"hút bớt phân dư" changes the source's "hút hết dinh dưỡng dư" (says "phân" instead of "dinh dưỡng", "bớt" instead of "hết"). The meaning survives but the wording is looser.

"Thảm thường mất khoảng 2–3 tháng mới kín": the hairgrass guide gives 2–3 months for growing without CO2, and the CO2 video says about three months. The passage drops that condition while also advising stable CO2.
"cỏ lên chậm hơn hẳn": the source only says "lên chậm hơn". Adding "hẳn" makes the slowdown sound much bigger than the INPUT does.
"thành một thảm thấp": the Tropica text says "thảm dày". Changing it to "thấp" shifts the meaning a little.
